_note: Portraits that were picked by eye from the artwork set on each artist's Apple Music page, because the page's og:image is either a publicity still or carries the Apple Music banner. Pass this to scripts/backfill_artist_images.py with --portrait-map so a later run does not put the old picture back. Each path is the picture already stored in the library's image folder, so no download is needed. The mzl.* set cannot be taken automatically: on 蔡琴's page it opens on a photograph of a man, and the set the page returns changes between requests.
